paper_metadata.title: SiGe Differential Transimpedance Amplifier With 50-GHz Bandwidth
paper_metadata.abstract: InP and SiGe technologies are both attractive for design of circuits operating at 40 GB/s and beyond. In this paper, we describe a fully differential SiGe transimpedance amplifier (TIA) suitable for differential phase-shift keying applications.
